svg.title: PilarPrep AWS Architecture - Official Service Icons
svg.desc: PilarPrep service architecture. Blue: brief generation and refinement. Green: handoff. Purple: catch-up. Amber: authenticated audio upload, GuardDuty scanning, transcription, and meeting analysis. The two EventBridge rules return to the same SQS queue and worker. The worker reads the private transcript before invoking AgentCore; the agent does not receive raw audio. WAF protects CloudFront. SQS redrives repeatedly failed deliveries to its dead-letter queue. Bedrock through Strands interprets the transcript and proposes packet corrections for human review. Customer context is preserved without PII detection or redaction. Bedrock Guardrails still apply. AgentCore internals are intentionally collapsed. CloudWatch, X-Ray, SNS, KMS, Secrets Manager, and IAM support the workload; they are not additional processing stages.
svg.text: Transcript completed: back to the same queue
